''See also: [[Regent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] are a group of powerful individuals who serve as representatives for the Emperor. Historically, they were personal companions to the Emperor and were intended to act as his successors. They are considered peers to the Emperor in terms of power, with some being regarded as his equals. The [[Regents]] typically remain in a state of rest until they are required to defend humanity against major threats, such as calamitous rebellions or the emergence of [[Great Elders]]. When they appear, they are often tasked with maintaining order among [[Guild Heads]] or combating powerful enemies. Several specific [[Regents]] are identified: [[Alagaeus]], the [[Regent of the East]]; [[Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin Maze-walker]], the [[Regent of the South]]; [[Loreli]], who holds titles including [[Regent of the West]] and founder of the [[Luminian Order]]; and [[Estyr Six]]. [[Loreli]] is described as a multifaceted figure—a strategist, warlord, healer, and religious icon known as the original [[Pilgrim]]. The [[Regents]] possess immense abilities; they are among the most formidable [[Readers]] in existence and can project an aura of peace or command significant respect through their presence.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|General Lore and History}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A Regent was once noted as a potential target or subject of consideration.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 1</ref> The [[Consultants]] later conducted an investigation into the death of a Regent.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref> It was determined that [[Benji]] and his group were responsible for killing a Regent.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> Additionally, a Regent was known to have fought against a [[Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Consultants]] are investigating the death of a [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Benji]] and his group killed a [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A [[Regent]] fought a [[Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Loreli's Regency}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|During this era, [[Loreli]] serves as the Regent.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> In her official capacity, she assisted the [[Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild]] with the construction of the crown's box.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> Should she locate [[Calder]], he faces the possibility of being imprisoned in a [[Palace cell]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Loreli]] is a [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Regent{{!}}Regent Loreli]] assisted the [[Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild]] in making the crown's box.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|If the [[Regent]] finds [[Calder]], he might end up in a [[Palace cell]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As some of the most powerful [[Readers]] to ever walk the earth, [[Regents]] hold significant influence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref> During a request for a report from [[Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius]], the Regent appeared surrounded by a hazy gray light.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> [[Loreli]], who is a Regent alongside [[Estyr]], wears silver-and-white [[Luminian armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> These [[Regents]] are responsible for handling [[Optasia]] business.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Regents]] are among the most powerful [[Readers]] to ever walk the earth.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regent]] asked [[Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius]] for a report.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regent]] is surrounded by a hazy gray light.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Regent{{!}}Regent Loreli]] wears silver-and-white [[Luminian armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli and Estyr]] are [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] handle [[Optasia]] business.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>
